Printed before pack-out: “any” lines have a blank per piece to write the tag or serial pulled. Printed after scanning, the scanned tags fill the blanks.

What changes and why

1
“2 × QSC K12.2” is one line with a progress count. The scans fill it in: under it are the units that went (DSL-0101 and DSL-0103, with serials). Lines from a lot (stands, cables) show a count only, since lot pieces have no tag.
2
An always-packed container (XLR Cable Box) is one line to check, with its contents listed underneath for reference; scanning CASE-02 covers all 21 pieces.
3
A container packed at checkout (Small XLR Cable Box) lists its “any” lines with progress, so the crew sees “3 more 15 ft cables to scan”. The box is ready when every line is full.
4
Print keeps the packing-list print layout. Each “any” line gets a blank per piece to write the tag or serial pulled; once scanned, the blanks print filled in. Equipment (the kit table) gains a short “Holds” column.
